Tasha (docs): Pushed a small PR to the private install guide to document CA/proxy cert bundling for air-gapped installs. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1350
Miguel (security): Great. Can you include a reproducible packaging example and checksum verification steps? Customers often ask how to build the tarball offline and verify integrity before importing.
Tasha (docs): Yep. Drafted a compact example (no inline comments in the code block so it's copy-paste friendly):
```
# create customer CA + proxy cert bundle
mkdir cert-bundle && cp /path/to/customer-ca.pem cert-bundle/ && cp /path/to/proxy-chain.pem cert-bundle/
tar czf redwood-ca-proxy-bundle.tar.gz cert-bundle/
# create checksum and sign (optional)
sha256sum redwood-ca-proxy-bundle.tar.gz > redwood-ca-proxy-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
# verify bundle locally after transfer (on air-gapped host)
sha256sum -c redwood-ca-proxy-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
# quick cert chain validation
tar xzf redwood-ca-proxy-bundle.tar.gz && openssl verify -CAfile cert-bundle/customer-ca.pem cert-bundle/proxy-chain.pem
```
Ravi (installer): For the installer I'd like a note that we accept a `--ca-bundle-path` flag and where the installer will stage the bundle (`/etc/redwood/cert-bundles/`), plus permission hints (owned by redwood:root, 0640).
Tasha (docs): Added the flag and the staging path in the prose, and a small snippet showing the systemd service drop-in to reload after bundle update: `systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart redwood-agent`
Olga (devex): Small nit: call out the offline transfer recommendation (use scp over a bastion or physical media) and a checksum mismatch troubleshooting line. Also change example filenames to placeholders like `<bundle-name>.tar.gz` and `<checksum-file>` so we don't ship literal names.
Tasha (docs): Replaced filenames with placeholders and added a troubleshooting bullet: "checksum mismatch -> do not import, re-transfer the bundle and verify transport integrity".
Miguel (security): Add explicit guidance for customers that use HSM-backed signing: if they sign the checksum file with a detached signature, show both `gpg --verify` and `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify` examples.
Tasha (docs): Added a short optional section with both GPG and openssl detached-sign verification examples. Kept them as prose with single-line commands to avoid big blocks.
ci-bot: docs site staging build passed (2026-03-24-0200) :white_check_mark:
Ravi (installer): After merge I'll wire the `--ca-bundle-path` to the installer preflight and add a smoke test to verify the `openssl verify` step runs if a bundle is provided. Filing an installer issue after.
Tasha (docs): Thanks! I'll mark the PR ready for review and ping security/devex for a final pass. Closing once merged.
